## Rules

- Finding defines captured fields per attachment pair: registry number, revision timestamps, uid, URL, title, response validators, byte hash, collection time and provenance; secrets/body contents are not committed. Branches exactly follow D8. Docs distinguish hash-version capability from orchestration guarantee. No external request without P4.1 owner authority. RAG:— (repo-grounded: D8).

## Guidance

This item is contract/docs/tests only; application diff must be empty. Add/adjust tests solely to demonstrate current behavior and protect wording, not to manufacture B2 closure. The live protocol must say `insufficient/replacements absent → bounded revalidation required`, not `no counterexample → immutable`. Define two sanitized machine carriers for P4.1: `artifacts/P4-a1-live-verification.json` with stable keys `schema_version`, `git_anchor`, `authority_sha256`, `scope_sha256`, `requests`, `pages`, `boundary_days`, `stop_reasons`, `verdict`, `evidence_ids`; and `artifacts/P4-b2-live-verification.json` with stable keys `schema_version`, `git_anchor`, `authority_sha256`, `scope_sha256`, `pairs`, `branch`, `revalidation_required`, `revalidation_validation`, `verdict`, `evidence_ids`. `branch` is exactly `changed_uid_observed`, `same_uid_different_hash` or `insufficient_evidence`; the last two require revalidation. Raw command output lives in `artifacts/`, factual normalization in `findings/`, synthesis/verdict in `research/`; each layer links hashes of the previous layer. If a docs file contains unrelated dirty hunks, apply surgical changes and preserve them.
